description: The system shall allow a delegated user to log in via their email address or phone number, so that they can access the application without a primary account.
The system must allow entering an email address or a phone number.
The system must send an OTP code to the indicated address or number.
The user must be able to enter the received OTP code.
If the code is correct, the user must log in successfully.
The system must handle authentication errors and incorrect codes.
The system shall allow an authenticated user to view a Home screen with relevant information about their business, in order to quickly check the status of their activity.
The Home screen must display several independent informative widgets.
Each widget must load its data autonomously.
The system must display loading and error states when necessary.
The visual layout must be consistent with the established design.
The system shall allow a Localboss user to receive intelligent response suggestions to reviews, in order to answer them more quickly, precisely, and professionally.
The system must detect whether the user has the Cintia functionality activated.
If Cintia is active, the system must show a response suggestion.
The suggestion must be generated automatically upon opening the response modal.
The system must display the response progressively (typing effect).
The user must be able to edit or replace the suggested response.
If the user does not have Cintia credits, they will be notified and will have a button to purchase them.
If the user does not see a response despite having credits, a button will appear to request the response.
The system shall allow a user to view images and videos associated with a review, in order to have more context about the customer's opinion.
The system must display the images and videos associated with a review.
The multimedia content must be displayed below the review text.
Images must be navigable via horizontal scroll.
Upon clicking an image or video, it must be displayed in full screen.
The system shall allow a user to access the application menu from different screens, to facilitate navigation and access to main functionalities.
The menu must be accessible from more than one screen.
Access to the menu must be done via the user's profile picture.
The behavior of the menu must be consistent with the rest of the application.
The application must provide an intuitive and coherent interface that allows users to complete main tasks (login, review consultation and response, use of Cintia) without prior training.
Main functionalities can be used without errors after a first use; no external instructions are required to complete basic actions.
The application must function correctly on Android and iOS devices with different screen sizes and supported operating system versions.
The application is displayed and functions correctly on Android and iOS emulators and physical devices.
System responses must have an acceptable response time, avoiding blocking or freezing of the user interface.
Main calls to the backend return a response in a time perceived as acceptable by the user.
User data must be transmitted and managed securely, ensuring that only authorized users can access the information.
Access to functionalities requires valid authentication and unauthorized access is not allowed.
Code must be structured following best practices and architectural patterns that facilitate system maintenance and evolution.
The code follows a clear architecture and is reviewable via PRs without difficulty.
